name: pystring.wasm
description: Python-like string manipulation functions compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p build && cd build && em++ -O3 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_pystring_capitalize","_pystring_center","_pystring_count","_pystring_endswith","_pystring_find","_pystring_index","_pystring_isalnum","_pystring_isalpha","_pystring_isdigit","_pystring_islower","_pystring_isspace","_pystring_isupper","_pystring_join","_pystring_ljust","_pystring_lower","_pystring_lstrip","_pystring_replace","_pystring_rfind","_pystring_rjust","_pystring_rstrip","_pystring_split","_pystring_startswith","_pystring_strip","_pystring_swapcase","_pystring_title","_pystring_upper","_pystring_zfill","_malloc","_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall","cwrap","HEAPU8","UTF8ToString","stringToUTF8"]' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=16MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=256MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=2MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -flto ../src/wasm_module.cpp ../pystring.cpp -o pystring.js

author: Superstruct WASM Contributors
